summary: TradeOS V2 Command Center transition end-to-end tested (backend + frontend). All 11 acceptance criteria from the review request are verified. Login as Scott (inbox@twofungis.ca) correctly redirects to /app/command-center. The page renders greeting 'Good morning, Scott Marshall' with 'TWO FUNGIS FINISHING' subtitle. Today's Focus shows empty 'All caught up!' state. Projects card renders all 4 rows (Starting Soon, In Progress, On Hold, Completed). Opportunities card renders phase groups Pipeline/Active Work/Outcomes with rows discovered, qualifying, tendering, submitted, negotiation, awarded, lost. Company Brain card renders with 'Ask Company Brain anything...' input. Quick Add (+New) opens panel with New Opportunity, New Project, Quick Note. Notifications bell present. Brain button visible in top-right (rendered by AppLayout for org members). Backend endpoints /api/command-center/health returns 200 healthy, /api/command-center/dashboard returns full aggregated payload (success=true, organization_name='Two Fungis Finishing', user_name='Scott Marshall', today_focus, projects, opportunities, recent_activity, brain_insights, quick_stats, generated_at). Auth guards enforced (401 on invalid token, 422 when Authorization header missing).
critical_code_review_comments: command_center.py verify_token_and_get_context() calls jwt.decode with options={'verify_signature': False} — this trusts any token whose payload has a 'sub' claim. Backend then performs an admin lookup at /auth/v1/admin/users/{user_id} using SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY which will only return data for real Supabase users, but the JWT itself is not verified. Consider verifying the signature with the JWT secret / Supabase JWKS to reject forged tokens up-front and to make the 401 path deterministic (currently a crafted JWT with a real user_id could pass auth without a valid signature).

The 'projects' aggregation maps status 'on_hold' / 'on hold' / 'issues' / 'deficiency' into the 'deficiencies' counter, but the UI renders that row as 'On Hold'. Rename the backend key to on_hold (or the UI to Deficiencies) for consistency, so future readers aren't confused when reading the API response vs the screen.

In command_center.py the today_focus deadline query uses tender_due_date=lt.{deadline_cutoff} which returns already-past deadlines as well. Consider adding gte.{now} so overdue items don't crowd out real 'today' focus items (or explicitly flag overdue ones as 'urgent overdue').
CompanyBrainCard 'action_link' click uses window.location.assign() which triggers a full page reload and drops React state. Prefer useNavigate(rec.action_link) for a smooth SPA transition.

In CommandCenterPage.jsx the polling interval (setInterval every 60s) keeps calling fetchDashboardData even when the tab is hidden. Consider pausing on document.visibilityState !== 'visible' to save Supabase quota, especially given the dashboard fires several Postgres queries per call.

CommandCenterPage.jsx logs to console with console.error on API failures but there is no user-facing retry beyond the top error banner. Consider surfacing per-card error states so a single failure (e.g. opportunities fetch) doesn't blank the whole card silently.

The dashboard endpoint fetches all projects/opportunities rows client-side to compute counts instead of using PostgREST count aggregations (Prefer: count=exact + head=true). For orgs with thousands of rows this will get slow. Consider moving to count queries per status bucket.
